basis: ASME B31.3 up to 2018 Appendix D (deleted in B31.3-2020, replaced by ASME B31J); same elbow formulas in ASME B31.1. Formulas cross-checked: S5 (whatispiping.com), S6 (projectmaterials.com), PSI psi/codes/b311.py (S3). Grade A for the bend formulas; the tee h factor differs between sources and editions (grade B).

symbols.r2: mean radius of the matching pipe = (Do - T)/2

welding_tee_b16_9.h: 3.1 T / r2 (B31.3 App. D); B31.1: 4.4 T/r when rx >= Db/8 and Tc >= 1.5 T, else 3.1 T/r (PSI implementation)
welding_tee_b16_9.grade: B — one blog quotes 4.4 T/r for legacy B31.3; edition-dependent, not a gate

b31j.status: ASME B31J-2017 (reaffirmed, B31J-2023 listed on the ASME catalogue) is mandatory for B31.3-2020 and later; its tables are not public. Values TBD — measure with a licensed B31J copy or CAESAR II B31J option.
